name: Rose Quartz Hydrating Serum
description: Infused with pure rose quartz extract and multi-weight hyaluronic acid, this weightless radiance serum intensely hydrates, plumps fine lines, and delivers a luminous, glass-skin finish.
ingredients: Aqua (Water), Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Sodium Hyaluronate, Quartz Extract, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Organic Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.
how_to_use: Apply 3-4 drops onto clean face and neck every morning and evening. Gently press into skin with fingertips using upward sweeping motions before your moisturizer.

name: Velvet Rose Matte Lipstick
description: A velvety-smooth, weightless liquid lipstick offering up to 12 hours of rich, hydrating berry-rose color that never dries out your lips.
benefits: Infused with Vitamin E and Jojoba Oil
Soft velvet finish with zero cracking
ingredients: Isododecane, Dimethicone, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Synthetic Wax, Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E), Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, CI 77891, CI 15850, CI 77491.
how_to_use: Outline lips using the precision tip of the wand, then fill in with soft even strokes. Allow 60 seconds to set into a transfer-resistant matte finish.

name: Botanical Hydra Repair Cream
description: Rich velvet repair moisturizer enriched with botanical ceramides, shea butter, and peony blossom elixir to soothe skin barriers overnight.
benefits: Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive
ingredients: Aqua, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Peony Extract, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Phytosphingosine, Squalane, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Rosa Extract.
how_to_use: Warm a pea-sized amount between fingertips and massage gently onto clean face, neck, and décolletage as the final step in your evening routine.

name: Golden Elixir Hair Nourishing Treatment
description: Luxurious lightweight hair serum crafted with cold-pressed Moroccan Argan Oil and Camellia essence for brilliant shine, heat protection, and silky softness.
benefits: Tames frizz and seal split ends instantly
Enhances natural shine without weighing hair down
ingredients: Cyclopentasiloxane, Dimethiconol, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Camellia Japonica Seed Oil, Sweet Almond Oil, Parfum, Tocopherol.
how_to_use: Rub 1-2 pumps between palms and apply through mid-lengths to ends on damp or dry hair. Do not rinse.

name: Blossom Royale Eau De Parfum
description: An enchanting floral fragrance featuring top notes of Fresh Bergamot and Pear, a heart of Damask Rose and White Peony, and a base of Soft Vanilla Musk.
benefits: Handcrafted luxury crystal bottle with rose gold cap
ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Fragrance (Parfum), Water (Aqua), Rosa Damascena Flower Extract, Bergamot Peel Oil, White Musk Accord, Limonene, Linalool, Citronellol.
how_to_use: Spritz lightly onto pulse points—wrists, neck, and behind ears. Do not rub wrists together to preserve fragrance top notes.

name: Luminous Glow Silk Primer
description: A radiant, pearl-infused makeup primer that smooths pores, blurs imperfections, and creates an iridescent candlelit glow.
benefits: Extends makeup longevity up to 16 hours
ingredients: Water, Cyclopentasiloxane, Mica, Pearl Powder, Glycerin, Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Niacinamide, Camellia Extract, Titanium Dioxide.
how_to_use: Smooth 1-2 pumps over clean face after skincare and allow 30 seconds to absorb before applying foundation or wearing alone for a natural glow.

name: Satin Scalp Detox Treatment
description: Pre-shampoo exfoliating scalp treatment formulated with pink Himalayan salt, tea tree oil, and apple cider vinegar to remove product buildup and revitalize hair follicles.
ingredients: Sodium Chloride (Pink Himalayan Salt), Water, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Apple Cider Vinegar, Tea Tree Leaf Oil, Peppermint Extract, Rosewater.
how_to_use: Part damp hair and massage scalp scrub into roots using gentle circular motions. Rinse thoroughly, then follow with shampoo and conditioner.

name: Celestial Moonlight Night Mist
description: A soothing pillow & body bedtime spray with French Lavender, Chamomile Blossom, and Warm Sandalwood designed to relax senses and promote restful sleep.
benefits: Dual-use for pillow, linen, and body
ingredients: Water (Aqua), Organic Alcohol, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Chamomilla Recutita Extract, Santalum Album (Sandalwood) Oil, Vanillin.
how_to_use: Mist lightly over body or spray 2-3 pumps onto pillow and bed linens 10 minutes before sleep.
